repos.description: 🎈 Updated daily! A list of popular BitTorrent Trackers! / 每天更新！全网热门 BT Tracker 列表！
repos.summary_zh: 每日更新的全网热门BT Tracker集合，专为加速BitTorrent等P2P客户端下载而生。提供多格式列表与Aria2配置，有效解决BT下载连接慢、资源少的核心痛点。
repos.summary_en: Daily-updated collection of popular BitTorrent Trackers, designed to significantly boost P2P download speeds in clients like qBittorrent and Aria2. Provides multi-format lists with fast CDN mirrors for easy setup and maximum peer connectivity.

repos.description: CF-workers/pages代理脚本：支持Vless-ws(tls)、Trojan-ws(tls)；Socks5/http本地代理脚本：可选ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式
repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于Cloudflare Workers/Pages，提供Vless和Trojan代理脚本，支持多种TLS模式，无需自定义域名和频繁更新节点，简化科学上网配置。适用于个人代理服务器搭建，具有懒人部署、多客户端订阅格式等亮点。
repos.summary_en: This project provides Vless and Trojan proxy scripts based on Cloudflare Workers/Pages, supporting multiple TLS modes. It simplifies proxy setup without custom domains or frequent node updates, ideal for personal proxy servers, featuring easy deployment and multiple client subscription formats.

repos.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.
repos.summary_zh: 仓库精选Cloudflare生态的开源工具与资源，帮助独立开发者提高效率、减少成本。覆盖图床、邮箱、博客、脚手架等多个类别，工具简单便捷，便于快速部署。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates a list of Cloudflare-based open-source tools, guides, and resources, designed to help indie developers boost efficiency and reduce costs. It covers various domains such as image hosting, email, blogs, scaffolds, URL shorteners, and website analytics, ensuring simplicity and ease of use for quick deployment.

repos.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.
repos.summary_zh: MyIP是一个开源、支持Docker一键自部署的全能IP工具箱，集成多源IP查询、WebRTC与DNS泄露检测、浏览器指纹分析、全球网速与延迟测试、MTR路由追踪及Whois查询。结合PWA技术支持，旨在为用户提供一站式网络隐私保护、连接质量诊断与基础设施深度探测解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MyIP is an open-source, all-in-one IP toolbox designed for comprehensive network diagnostics and privacy protection. Self-hostable via a single Docker command and supported as a PWA, it integrates multi-source IP lookup, WebRTC & DNS leak detection, browser fingerprinting, global speed and latency tests, MTR, and Whois queries. It provides users with an all-in-one solution for security assessment and infrastructure exploration.

repos.description: 致力于成为中文区命中率最高的广告过滤列表，实现精确的广告屏蔽和隐私保护。anti-AD 现已支持 AdGuardHome，dnsmasq，Surge，Pi-Hole，Clash, mihomo，smartdns，sing-box 等网络组件。完全兼容常见的广告过滤工具所支持的各种广告过滤列表格式
repos.summary_zh: anti-AD 是专注于中文区的高命中率广告过滤与隐私保护列表，通过合并、优化主流 hosts 及 adblock 规则并剔除失效域名，实现 DNS 层面的精准屏蔽。全面兼容 AdGuardHome、Clash、Surge、sing-box 等主流网络组件，有效拦截电视盒子、App 内置广告及隐私追踪站点，守护个人隐私。
repos.summary_en: anti-AD is a high-hit-rate ad filtering and privacy protection list tailored for the Chinese region. By merging and optimizing mainstream hosts and adblock rules while removing dead domains, it achieves precise blocking at the DNS layer. Fully compatible with AdGuardHome, Clash, Surge, and sing-box, it effectively blocks TV box ads, in-app ads, and privacy trackers.

repos.description: MoonTV/LunaTV源配置，每日自动检测API状态，可在CF部署CORSAPI中转被墙API，本人提供的CORSAPI仅为测试使用，请勿滥用！
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供MoonTV/LunaTV的多种配置源，包括精简、完整及成人版本，满足不同用户需求。内置基于Cloudflare Workers的CORSAPI代理服务，可中转被墙API并自动添加代理前缀，解决跨域限制。支持Base58编码订阅生成，部署简便，适用于TV应用配置与API代理场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers multiple configuration sources for MoonTV/LunaTV, including simplified, full, and adult versions, to meet diverse user needs. It features a CORSAPI proxy service based on Cloudflare Workers, which can relay blocked APIs and automatically add proxy prefixes, addressing cross-origin restrictions. It supports Base58-encoded subscription generation, with easy deployment, suitable for TV app configuration and API proxy scenarios.

repos.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers
repos.summary_zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的Bitwarden兼容密码管理服务器，支持Passkey无密码认证、离线PWA及多用户。利用边缘计算实现高效实时同步，适用于安全自托管凭据管理。
repos.summary_en: NodeWarden is a highly compatible, self-hostable Bitwarden server running on Cloudflare Workers. It delivers robust credential security with features like passwordless passkey authentication, offline PWA capabilities, multi-user invite systems, seamless real-time sync, and flexible cloud backup options, leveraging the power of serverless edge computing.

repos.description: AI-native knowledge base & Evernote/Obsidian alternative with instant sync & native MCP. Free on Cloudflare or self-hosted via Docker.
repos.summary_zh: EdgeEver 是一个 AI 原生的开源知识库应用，旨在替代 Evernote 和 Obsidian。它提供经典的 Evernote 式三栏布局，支持即时多设备同步，并原生集成 AI Agent 以提升生产力。用户可免费在 Cloudflare 上运行，或通过 Docker 自托管，确保数据完全拥有。适用于个人和团队的知识管理场景。
repos.summary_en: EdgeEver is an AI-native, open-source knowledge base application designed as an alternative to Evernote and Obsidian. It offers a classic Evernote-style three-pane layout with instant multi-device sync and native AI Agent integration for enhanced productivity. Users can run it for free on Cloudflare or self-host via Docker, ensuring complete data ownership. Suitable for personal and team knowledge management.

repos.description: 适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS的去广告规则，合并优质上游规则并去重整理排列。
repos.summary_zh: GOODBYEADS是一个强力去广告规则集合，专为AdGuard、Quantumult X和SmartDNS设计。它合并多个优质上游规则并去重整理，提供海量拦截规则、DNS拦截规则及白名单，支持多种格式下载，并定时更新，有效提升广告拦截效果与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: GOODBYEADS is a powerful ad-blocking rule collection designed for AdGuard, Quantumult X, and SmartDNS. It merges high-quality upstream rules, deduplicates and organizes them, providing massive blocking rules, DNS blocking rules, and whitelists. With multi-format support and regular updates, it enhances ad-blocking effectiveness and privacy protection.

repos.description: Cloudflare超级代理，无服务器代理，Duckduckgo代理（可用AI聊天，包含GPT4o/Claude3），Github加速，支持解锁Libgen，在线代理。现已支持多平台部署。Cloudflare super proxy, setting up a free serverless proxy by using Cloudflare worker, support Duckduckgo / Libgen. Now you can deploy this project on different platforms.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Cloudflare无服务器架构的超级反向代理，支持多平台部署。可加速访问Github、解锁DuckDuckGo AI大模型及Libgen，具备Cookie安全隔离、防SNI检测和密码保护，是安全高效的在线代理方案。
repos.summary_en: A powerful serverless reverse proxy built on Cloudflare Workers, supporting multi-platform deployment. It accelerates access to Github, unlocks DuckDuckGo AI chat (GPT4o/Claude3) and Libgen, offering secure cookie scoping, SNI masking, and password protection, serving as a robust solution for secure proxy learning.

repos.description: XUI-PRO nginx reverse proxy with ws/grpc/httpupgrade/splithttp,xray protocol support: vless,vmess,trojan,shadowsocks panel cloudflare ssl,xtls,ssr,v2fly,v2ray installer bypass restrictions sing-box,shadowtls,reality,tunnel,gfw tor warp wireguard geoip tuic clash vpn mihomo psiphon hy2 oneclick argo bbr wstunnel anticensorship⚡🛡️
repos.summary_zh: x-ui-pro 是一款集成 Nginx、Xray、Warp、Tor 的多协议抗审查代理面板自动安装脚本。支持 vless、trojan 等协议及 WebSocket/GRPC，具备多用户多域名部署、自动 SSL 续期、随机伪装页面等功能，适用于突破网络限制与安全代理场景。
repos.summary_en: x-ui-pro is an open-source auto-installation script designed to deploy a lightweight, highly secure multi-protocol web proxy panel. Integrating Nginx, Xray, Warp, Tor, and Psiphon, it supports advanced protocols like VLESS and Trojan over WebSocket, GRPC, and XHTTP. Optimized for bypassing censorship, it offers multi-domain management, auto SSL renewal, and low detection signatures.

repos.description: A Bitwarden-compatible server for Cloudflare Workers
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的无服务器 Bitwarden 兼容密码管理服务器。利用 D1 存储与 KV/R2 附件，提供免费、零维护的个人 vault 方案，支持实时同步、TOTP 与文件发送，完美兼容官方客户端。
repos.summary_en: A serverless, Bitwarden-compatible password manager server designed for Cloudflare Workers. Utilizing Cloudflare D1 for storage and KV/R2 for attachments, it provides a completely free, low-maintenance, and highly secure personal vault solution. Features include core vault operations, live sync, TOTP support, and official client compatibility.

repos.description: 🔥🔥🔥一行命令，轻松搞定SSL证书自动续期。 SSL泛域名证书，SSL证书管理，SSL证书自动续期，SSL证书自动更新，七牛云、阿里云、腾讯云、CDN、OSS、https证书管理,https证书管理,免费SSL证书,TLS证书自动续签,nginx证书自动续期工具，nginx证书管理。从此告别Let's Encrypt
repos.summary_zh: httpsok 是一款高效的 SSL 证书自动续期工具，专为 Nginx、Apache 等服务器设计。通过一行命令实现证书自动检测、续签和更新，支持泛域名、多服务器及主流云服务如 CDN、OSS。兼容性强，提供监控提醒，简化运维流程，确保网站安全。
repos.summary_en: httpsok is an efficient SSL certificate auto-renewal tool designed for Nginx, Apache, etc. It enables one-command auto-detection, renewal, and update of certificates for wildcard domains and multiple servers, compatible with cloud services like CDN and OSS. Offers strong compatibility and monitoring alerts, simplifying operations and ensuring security.

repos.description: 🚗 智能挪车通知系统 - 基于 Cloudflare Workers，支持实时位置共享和多推送服务
repos.summary_zh: MoveCar 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的智能挪车通知系统，通过扫码联系车主而不暴露电话号码，保护隐私。系统支持双向实时位置共享，请求者可留言并获取位置，车主通过 Bark 推送接收通知并确认。利用 Serverless 架构实现免费部署和零运维，同时通过 30 秒延迟机制有效防止恶意扫码骚扰。
repos.summary_en: MoveCar is an intelligent car move notification system based on Cloudflare Workers. It allows users to notify car owners by scanning a QR code without exposing phone numbers, thus protecting privacy. The system supports bidirectional real-time location sharing, enabling requesters to leave messages and share locations, while owners receive notifications via Bark push service. Leveraging serverless architecture for free deployment and zero maintenance, it also prevents malicious scanning through a 30-second delay mechanism.

repos.description: VLESS+XHTTP+TLS Auto-Installer for Ubuntu — Vercel / Netlify relay
repos.summary_zh: 一键在Ubuntu部署VLESS+XHTTP+TLS代理，通过Vercel/Netlify CDN中继流量，有效隐藏服务器真实IP以防封锁。支持自动SSL签发与智能修复，快速构建安全、高速、难被过滤的匿名代理通道。
repos.summary_en: Automates VLESS+XHTTP+TLS proxy setup on Ubuntu, masking the server IP via Vercel/Netlify CDN relay. Provides one-click deployment, auto SSL, and smart repair for secure, high-speed, anti-blocking access.

repos.description: 基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘。以 Telegram 为核心（支持 Webhook 直传与 2GB 扩展），并全面兼容 R2、S3、Discord 及 HuggingFace 等多存储后端。零成本构建你的全能私有数据金库。
repos.summary_zh: K-Vault 是基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘，集成 Telegram、R2、S3、Discord、HuggingFace 等多存储后端，实现零成本私有数据托管。通过 Webhook 直传与 KV 优化，提供高效上传、预览与管理，适用于个人图片分享与文件存储。
repos.summary_en: K-Vault is a Serverless aggregated cloud drive on Cloudflare, supporting Telegram, R2, S3, Discord, HuggingFace, and more for zero-cost private storage. With Webhook direct upload and KV optimization, it enables efficient file upload, preview, and management for personal image and file sharing.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于Cloudflare Workers实现体育赛事直播源的自动化订阅服务，支持TXT和M3U格式，通过授权码机制保障访问安全。适用于体育爱好者实时获取赛事直播信息，具有免费部署、无需服务器、跨平台访问等技术亮点。
repos.summary_en: This project provides automated subscription services for sports event live streams based on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TXT and M3U formats with authorization code access. It is suitable for sports fans to get real-time live event information, featuring free deployment, serverless architecture, and cross-platform accessibility.

repos.description: RenewHelper - 时序·守望是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期提醒、管理工具。它专为管理周期性订阅、域名续费、服务器到期等场景设计。无需服务器，零成本托管，提供精美的机甲风（Mecha-style）UI 界面、强大的农历/公历计算核心、多渠道通知推送能力、iCal日程同步以及账单管理功能。同时支持Worker和Docker方式部署。
repos.summary_zh: RenewHelper - 时序·守望 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的全栈服务生命周期管理工具，专为周期性订阅、域名续费和服务器到期等场景设计。它提供公历与农历智能周期计算、多渠道通知推送、iCal 日历同步、资金流向看板以及 JWT 安全认证，支持 Serverless 和 Docker 部署，拥有精美的机甲风 UI 和响应式设计。
repos.summary_en: RenewHelper - Timeline Watch is a full-stack service lifecycle management tool based on Cloudflare Workers, designed for managing periodic subscriptions, domain renewals, and server expirations. It features intelligent solar and lunar calendar cycle calculations, multi-channel notifications, iCal calendar sync, financial dashboards, and JWT authentication. Supports Serverless and Docker deployment with a mecha-style UI and responsive design.

repos.description: An all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare. Manage Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference & browser rendering visually, with an OpenAI-compatible API for external integration.
repos.summary_zh: CF Manager 是 Cloudflare 多账号统一管理平台，支持 Workers、DNS、存储及 AI 推理的可视化操作。面向多账号开发者与运维人员，解决账号切换与批量操作痛点。技术亮点包括内置 OpenAI 兼容接口与自托管部署，实现本地调试与数据自主控制。
repos.summary_en: CF Manager is an all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare, enabling visual management of Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference, and browser rendering. It is designed for developers and operators with multiple Cloudflare accounts, solving the pain of account switching and batch operations. Key features include an OpenAI-compatible API for local debugging and self-hosted deployment for full data control.

repos.description: an AI Github Rlease Tracker Powered by Cloudflare
repos.summary_zh: GitPush是一个基于Cloudflare的AI驱动GitHub发布追踪工具。它自动监控用户指定的仓库，利用Workers AI集成DeepSeek R1生成智能摘要，并通过邮件通知。适用于开发者、开源贡献者和技术产品经理，无需本地部署，通过云版本即可快速简化跨仓库的发布跟踪流程。
repos.summary_en: GitPush is an AI-powered GitHub release tracker on Cloudflare. It monitors specified repositories, generates AI summaries using Workers AI with DeepSeek R1, and sends email notifications. Designed for developers, open-source contributors, and tech product managers, it simplifies tracking multiple releases with serverless deployment and no local setup.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 构建的轻量级博客系统，集成 MCP 协议支持 AI 智能体管理，具备高性能缓存、安全加固和 SEO 优化，适用于个人与企业快速搭建功能丰富的网站，助力高效内容创作与管理。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight blog system built on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2, featuring MCP protocol support for AI agent management. It offers high-performance caching, security hardening, and SEO optimization, suitable for quickly building feature-rich websites for individuals and enterprises.

repos.description: 运行在 Hono.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务，支持Cloudflare Worker部署
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Hono.js 的 LX Music 数据同步服务，通过 Cloudflare Workers 和 Durable Objects 实现有状态 WebSocket 实时同步。无需自托管服务器，支持多用户隔离、快照合并与增量同步，一键部署，适用于多设备歌单与偏好同步。
repos.summary_en: An LX Music data sync service built on Hono.js, leveraging Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects for stateful WebSocket real-time sync. Serverless deployment with multi-user isolation, snapshot merging, incremental sync, and one-click deployment. Ideal for syncing playlists and preferences across devices.
